summary: The customer was unexpectedly charged twice for their monthly subscription this morning and is asking for a fix.
formal:
Dear Customer, 

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We apologize for the inconvenience regarding the duplicate charge. As per our policy, if two identical completed charges appear for the same period, the duplicate is a billing error. We will confirm both transaction IDs in the admin panel and process a full refund for the duplicate charge.
empathetic: I am so sorry to see that you were charged twice this morning! I completely understand how frustrating that can be. Please rest assured that we will look into this right away; if two identical completed charges appear for the same period, it is a billing error, and we will confirm both transaction IDs in the admin panel and refund the duplicate in full for you.
short: We apologize for the duplicate charge this morning. Since two identical completed charges appear for the same period, we will confirm both transaction IDs in the admin panel and refund the duplicate in full.

summary: The customer was charged $59.99 yesterday after forgetting to cancel their annual plan free trial. They are requesting a refund.
formal: Dear Customer, regarding your request for a refund of $59.99 for your annual plan charged yesterday, please be advised that under our refund policy, web purchases made at the Nebula website checkout can be refunded within 14 days of the charge if the paid feature was not substantially used. Additionally, if the first charge happened less than 7 days ago and the app was not used after the charge, you are eligible for a refund. Please confirm whether you have used the app since the charge so we can process your request.
empathetic: Hello, I understand how frustrating it is to accidentally be charged after forgetting to cancel a trial, especially for $59.99 yesterday. We want to help! According to our policies, if the first charge happened less than 7 days ago and the app was not used after the charge, you are eligible for a refund. Could you please let us know if you have used the app since the charge?
short: You are eligible for a refund if the charge happened less than 7 days ago and the app was not used after the charge. Please let us know if you have used the app since yesterday's charge so we can proceed.

If you still cannot sign in, please provide your device model, OS version and app version for further assistance.

Please check your spam and promotions folders, keeping in mind that corporate mail filters sometimes block these emails. Also, remember that links expire after 15 minutes and only the latest link works. If you still cannot sign in, please let us know your device model, OS version and app version so we can escalate this to Tech support.

Зазвичай білий екран при відкритті натальної карти зникає, якщо очистити кеш (для Android) або переустановити застосунок (для iOS). Сподіваюся, це допоможе!
short: Оновіть застосунок, перезавантажте телефон та перевірте наявність 1 ГБ вільної пам'яті. Для натальної карти очистьте кеш (Android) або переустановіть застосунок (iOS) (джерело: app-crash).

summary: The customer is unhappy because they received a generic, duplicate personal reading that their friend also received. They are complaining about the quality of the content.
formal: Dear Customer, we sincerely apologize that you received a duplicate reading. Paid personal readings are written for the customer's chart, and if two customers received identical paid readings, it is a content error that qualifies you for a refund [how-horoscopes-work]. Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method and typically appear in your bank within 5–10 business days [refund-policy]. We have processed your refund request accordingly.
empathetic: We are so sorry to hear that your personal reading was identical to your friend's—that is definitely not the unique experience we want you to have. Since paid personal readings are supposed to be written specifically for your chart, receiving identical content is a content error, and you are fully eligible for a refund [how-horoscopes-work]. We are processing this for you now, and the funds will return to your original payment method within 5–10 business days [refund-policy]. Thank you for letting us know.
short: We apologize for the duplicate reading. Identical paid readings are considered a content error, making you eligible for a refund [how-horoscopes-work]. Your refund will be sent to your original payment method within 5–10 business days [refund-policy].
